findings.summary: Two relevant outdoor-retail competitor benchmarks now have same-query coverage for the protected 175-example set.

Same-query averages remain available in reference tables: High Country search 94/100 and autocomplete 45/100; Half-Moon search 99/100 and autocomplete 38/100; Mast search 84/100 and autocomplete 37/100. The current executive pages use these comparable retailers only as reference examples, keep exact values in references, and avoid winner/loser language. Public Lands remains blocked/403 in structured evidence. Recommendation: use competitor evidence as opportunity context and framework benchmark, not market-share, ad-spend, or broad competitor-superiority proof; broaden the competitor cohort before stronger comparison claims.

findings.title: Woo report summaries are not drillable to the underlying call
findings.summary: Operator: reports must be debuggable — summary -> experiment (which literals passed/intents failed) -> specific call (url+params+result) -> replay to verify reproducibility. Evidence-for-everything applied to Woo.

findings.title: Summary numbers are not navigable to their backing
findings.summary: Operator: a claimed count (e.g. failures/findings) with nothing to see below is a dead end. Make every summary number clickable to jump to the items behind it, so numbers are self-verifiable.

findings.title: Home Depot is out of scope: custom enterprise stack + Akamai bot wall + robots disallow
findings.summary: Operator requested a full evaluation of homedepot.com. Detected: custom enterprise platform (THD) behind Akamai (not Shopify/WooCommerce; products.json + wp-json both 404). Every automated request returns 403 Access Denied from Akamai Bot Manager (_bman/akavpau cookies) even with a browser UA. robots.txt explicitly disallows the discovery surfaces we inspect (/*Search?*, /*Ntt-*, /*Ntk-*, /*AjaxNavigation*). A full evaluation would require bypassing bot protection and ignoring robots.txt on disallowed paths — declined. No run performed, no bypass attempted. Legitimate path would be an authorized API / partner access or a consented manual evaluation.
